column15: bit 0 = ResetAlarm; bit 1 = CommandedTrip; bit 2 = OnOffReq (1 = on/start, 0 = off/stop); bit 3 = ProtectionEnabled (1 = enabled); bit 5 = ResetStartCounter; bit 6 = ResetRestartCounter; bit 7 = ResetLogs (min/max logs 00348-00352); bit 8 = ResetHourCounter (operating-time trip counter); bit 9 = ResetEnergyCounter (energy trip counter)
bit 0 = Rotation (motor consuming power); bit 1 = Protection enabled; bit 2 = Ready; bit 3 = Unacknowledged fault pending; bit 4 = PTC open; bit 5 = Phase sequence left (L3-L2-L1)
0 = Started (on); 1 = Commanded trip; 2 = Actuator stop (off); 3 = Protection stop (alarm trip)

column7: Cause of the last motor protection trip.

bit 0 = Overvoltage (32); bit 1 = Undervoltage (40); bit 2 = Overload (48); bit 3 = Underload (56); bit 4 = Current asymmetry (111); bit 8 = Insulation resistance low (20); bit 9 = Overtemperature Tempcon (64); bit 10 = Overtemperature Pt100 (71); bit 12 = Cos phi too high (112); bit 13 = Cos phi too low (113); bit 14 = Too many starts per hour (21)

bit 0 = Motor control relay closed; bit 1 = Alarm signal relay closed
